property_summary: For any call to setDAO(dao) made before configuration, if the caller is neither the current DAO nor an unconfigured contract, the DAO can only be updated by the current DAO (or before configuration), so after endConfiguration() a non-DAO caller's setDAO must not change c.DAO(); the bug lets any caller overwrite DAO post-configuration.
change_summary: Delete the require guard in setDAO, allowing DAO to be overwritten after configuration or by any caller.
